Alphabet FY2022 revenue: $282,836M; FY2024 revenue: $350,018M. [DOC-1]

Meta FY2022 revenue: $116,609M; FY2024 revenue: $164,501M. [DOC-1]

Assuming fiscal years and reporting bases are directly comparable (both standard calendar-year 10-Ks with no noted restatements in the excerpt):

- Alphabet cumulative revenue growth FY2022→FY2024  
  = (350,018 − 282,836) / 282,836  
  ≈ 67,182 / 282,836 ≈ 23.8% [DOC-1]

- Meta cumulative revenue growth FY2022→FY2024  
  = (164,501 − 116,609) / 116,609  
  ≈ 47,892 / 116,609 ≈ 41.1% [DOC-1]

Difference in cumulative growth ≈ 41.1% − 23.8% ≈ 17 percentage points.

ANSWER: Meta, by roughly 17 percentage points
